items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind announces Gemini 4 Carbon as next frontier model with cybersecurity focus
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 宣布 Gemini 4 Carbon 為下一款前沿模型，聚焦網路安全
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 4 Carbon on October 28 as its strongest model, ranking #1 on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0 at 59 with state-of-the-art cybersecurity performance (e.g., 88.2% on SEC-bench Pro for vulnerabilities, 54.8% on ExploitGym, 71.0% on CWE-bench). It is initially available to a subset of cyber defenders via the Fairwind Program while undergoing U.S. voluntary pre-release testing, at introductory pricing of $2/$10 per million tokens.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 於 10 月 28 日宣布 Gemini 4 Carbon 為其最強模型，在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0 以 59 分奪冠，並在網路安全任務（如 SEC-bench Pro 88.2%）表現領先。初期僅向 Fairwind 計畫的網路防禦者開放，正接受美國自願預發布測試，入門價格為每百萬 token $2/$10。
items_flat.analysis_en: Carbon demonstrates rapid iteration in Google’s Gemini 4 series and prioritizes high-stakes defense use cases, but staged rollout and reliance on internal/external benchmarks leave independent validation and broad availability timelines uncertain.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Carbon 顯示 Gemini 4 系列快速迭代並優先高風險防禦用例，但分階段推出與依賴內外部基準，使獨立驗證與廣泛可用時間仍不確定。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re announcing the next frontier model: Gemini 4 Carbon, our strongest model with state-of-the-art cybersecurity and long horizon capabilities.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們宣布下一款前沿模型：Gemini 4 Carbon，我們最強的模型，具備最先進的網路安全與長視野能力。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI and ServiceNow expand partnership to connect workflows with ChatGPT and Codex
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 與 ServiceNow 擴大合作，將工作流程連接至 ChatGPT 與 Codex
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI and ServiceNow announced an expansion on October 28 bringing ServiceNow business context and governed actions into ChatGPT via a new MCP plugin (available now), while planning Codex integration for app development, joint cybersecurity solutions, and broader employee access to ChatGPT Work and Codex. Most advanced features are slated for late 2026–2027.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 與 ServiceNow 於 10 月 28 日宣布擴大合作，透過新 MCP 外掛將 ServiceNow 業務上下文與受控行動帶入 ChatGPT（現已可用），並規劃 Codex 整合用於應用開發、聯合網路安全方案，以及擴大員工對 ChatGPT Work 與 Codex 的存取。多數進階功能預定於 2026 年底至 2027 年推出。
items_flat.analysis_en: The deal advances agentic enterprise execution inside existing governed systems, but most advanced capabilities remain planned for 2027, so near-term impact depends on plugin adoption and integration depth.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此交易推進在既有受控系統內的代理式企業執行，但多數進階能力仍規劃於 2027 年，近端影響取決於外掛採用與整合深度。
items_flat.quote: AI becomes more useful when people can put it to work in the systems their businesses depend on.
items_flat.quote_zh: 當人們能在企業所依賴的系統中運用 AI 時，AI 會變得更有用。

items_flat.title_en: Google DeepMind announces Genie 4 world model with native audio and real-time steering
items_flat.title_zh: Google DeepMind 宣布 Genie 4 世界模型，具備原生音訊與即時導引
items_flat.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced Genie 4, a next-generation world model that generates photorealistic interactive environments with native audio (ambient sound, music, dialogue) and allows real-time natural-language steering of scenes. Simulations incorporate Gemini Omni and other Gemini models for coherence; it is in research preview for trusted testers, with broader access planned for Google AI Ultra and API partners.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 宣布 Genie 4，新一代世界模型可生成具原生音訊（環境音、音樂、對話）的擬真互動環境，並允許以自然語言即時導引場景。模擬整合 Gemini Omni 等模型以維持連貫性；目前向受信任測試者提供研究預覽，計畫擴大至 Google AI Ultra 與 API 合作夥伴。
items_flat.analysis_en: Genie 4 advances interactive simulation for robotics training, creative tools and agent evaluation, but coherence remains limited to short sessions and object permanence can still degrade.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Genie 4 推進機器人訓練、創意工具與代理評估的互動模擬，但連貫性仍限於短時段，物件持久性仍可能下降。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re announcing our research on Genie 4, our new world model that brings unprecedented realism and native audio to real-time interactive simulation.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們宣布 Genie 4 的研究，我們的新世界模型為即時互動模擬帶來前所未有的擬真度與原生音訊。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic reports early progress accelerating drug development with Claude
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 報告使用 Claude 加速藥物開發的早期進展
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic detailed partnerships with six organizations (including Generate Biomedicines, BigHat, Divergence Labs, Enveda, The Column Group and Bristol Myers Squibb) using Claude across modality design, hit generation, lead optimization, manufacturing and regulatory drafting. Most results remain preclinical; Anthropic also acquired Mithril Medicine.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 詳述與六家機構（包括 Generate Biomedicines、BigHat、Divergence Labs、Enveda、The Column Group 與 Bristol Myers Squibb）的合作，使用 Claude 涵蓋模態設計、命中生成、先導優化、製造與法規草稿。多數成果仍屬臨床前；Anthropic 亦收購 Mithril Medicine。
items_flat.analysis_en: The case studies show Claude handling distributed bottlenecks from design to regulatory drafts, but most work remains preclinical. Translating mouse results and operational gains into approved therapies is still unproven.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 案例顯示 Claude 處理從設計到法規草稿的分散瓶頸，但多數工作仍屬臨床前。將小鼠結果與營運增益轉化為核准療法仍未經證實。
items_flat.quote: We're at the start of a major effort to speed up drug development with Claude.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們正處於使用 Claude 加速藥物開發的重大努力起步階段。

items_flat.title_en: Meta partners with five US universities, providing $2M and Muse model access for science and medicine
items_flat.title_zh: Meta 與五所美國大學合作，提供 200 萬美元與 Muse 模型存取以推進科學與醫學
items_flat.summary_en: Meta announced partnerships on October 28 with Caltech, Ohio State College of Medicine, LSU, Indiana University and UTHealth Houston, granting $2 million across projects plus access to Muse models (including Wonder, Spark Open, Glimmer), computer vision models and SeamlessM4T for research in medicine, physics, chemistry, biology and mathematics.
items_flat.summary_zh: Meta 於 10 月 28 日宣布與 Caltech、Ohio State 醫學院、LSU、Indiana University 與 UTHealth Houston 合作，提供共 200 萬美元並開放 Muse 模型（包括 Wonder、Spark Open、Glimmer）、電腦視覺模型與 SeamlessM4T，用於醫學、物理、化學、生物與數學研究。
items_flat.analysis_en: The initiative extends Meta’s open-weight models into applied academic research, particularly healthcare, but outcomes will depend on how effectively teams translate model access into validated scientific results.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此計畫將 Meta 的開放權重模型延伸至應用學術研究，尤其是醫療保健，但成果將取決於團隊如何有效將模型存取轉化為經過驗證的科學結果。
items_flat.quote: Today we're announcing support for university research at Caltech, Ohio State Med, LSU, Indiana Univ, and UTHealth Houston to help advance breakthroughs across science and medicine.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天我們宣布支持 Caltech、Ohio State Med、LSU、Indiana Univ 與 UTHealth Houston 的大學研究，以協助推進科學與醫學的突破。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic introduces ready-to-use artifacts gallery for Claude for Legal
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 為 Claude for Legal 推出現成可用的成果圖庫
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic launched a gallery of ready-to-use interactive artifacts for Claude for Legal, covering contract review, cite checking, regulatory horizon scans, tabular review and more. Teams can adapt them with their own data and 60+ legal connectors.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 為 Claude for Legal 推出現成可用的互動成果圖庫，涵蓋合約審查、引用檢查、法規視野掃描、表格審查等。團隊可使用自身資料與超過 60 個法律連接器進行調整。
items_flat.analysis_en: The move shifts Claude from pure chat toward structured legal workflows, addressing common requests for easier collaboration. Success depends on how well artifacts reduce review time in practice.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此舉將 Claude 從純聊天轉向結構化法律工作流程，回應更易協作的常見需求。成功取決於成果在實務中能多好地縮短審查時間。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing ready-to-use artifacts that legal professionals can adapt to how their teams work and share with colleagues across the business.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出法律專業人士可依團隊工作方式調整、並與企業同事分享的即用型artifacts。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic expands GSA partnership with 40% discount for all levels of US government
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 擴大 GSA 合作，為美國各級政府提供 40% 折扣
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic expanded its GSA agreement to offer a 40% discount on Claude Enterprise, Claude for Government and the Claude API across federal, state, local, tribal and territorial governments, with no minimum spend. Roughly 500 government organizations already use Claude.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 擴大 GSA 協議，為聯邦、州、地方、部落與領地政府提供 Claude Enterprise、Claude for Government 與 Claude API 40% 折扣，無最低消費。約 500 個政府組織已使用 Claude。
items_flat.analysis_en: The discount lowers barriers for public-sector adoption amid long procurement cycles and tight budgets, but actual uptake still depends on security authorizations and agency implementation.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此折扣在漫長採購週期與緊縮預算中降低公共部門採用門檻，但實際採用仍取決於安全授權與機構執行。
items_flat.quote: We are expanding our partnership with the General Services Administration (GSA) through a new agreement that gives government partners a 40% discount on Claude Enterprise, Claude for Government, and the Claude API.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們透過新協議擴大與總務署（GSA）的合作，給予政府合作夥伴在Claude Enterprise、Claude for Government與Claude API上40%的折扣。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI expands Oracle partnership to bring apps and data into ChatGPT
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 擴大與 Oracle 的合作，將應用與資料帶入 ChatGPT
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI and Oracle announced an expansion that will bring Oracle applications and data into ChatGPT via Oracle AI Workspace (in development), while powering new Oracle offerings such as AI Security Mesh, an SMB Bundle with ChatGPT Business and Codex, and App Composer.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 與 Oracle 宣布擴大合作，將透過 Oracle AI Workspace（開發中）把 Oracle 應用與資料帶入 ChatGPT，同時支援 Oracle AI Security Mesh、含 ChatGPT Business 與 Codex 的 SMB 套裝，以及 App Composer 等新產品。
items_flat.analysis_en: The deal deepens enterprise distribution for ChatGPT and Codex inside existing Oracle procurement flows, but Oracle AI Workspace remains in development and the practical depth of data access is still unclear.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此交易深化 ChatGPT 與 Codex 在既有 Oracle 採購流程中的企業分銷，但 Oracle AI Workspace 仍在開發中，資料存取的實際深度仍不清楚。
items_flat.quote: OpenAI and Oracle are bringing Oracle applications and data into ChatGPT and powering new Oracle products and services with OpenAI models and products.
items_flat.quote_zh: OpenAI與Oracle正將Oracle應用與資料帶入ChatGPT，並以OpenAI模型與產品驅動新的Oracle產品與服務。

items_flat.title_en: Gemini Robotics Embodied Reasoning 2 enters public preview on Google Cloud
items_flat.title_zh: Gemini Robotics Embodied Reasoning 2 在 Google Cloud 進入公開預覽
items_flat.summary_en: Google Cloud made Gemini Robotics Embodied Reasoning 2 (ER 2) available in public preview on the Gemini platform. The specialized model serves as a high-level robot brain for spatial-temporal reasoning, long-horizon planning, self-correction and tool use.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google Cloud 讓 Gemini Robotics Embodied Reasoning 2 (ER 2) 在 Gemini 平台進入公開預覽。此專用模型作為高階機器人大腦，用於時空推理、長視野規劃、自我修正與工具使用。
items_flat.analysis_en: Putting a frontier embodied-reasoning model into production cloud tooling lowers the barrier for enterprise physical AI, but real-world reliability, safety guardrail performance and latency remain open questions.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 將前沿具身推理模型放入生產雲端工具降低企業實體 AI 門檻，但真實世界可靠性、安全防護表現與延遲仍是開放問題。
items_flat.quote: Today, we are bringing this same frontier embodied reasoning model to enterprise production environments: Gemini Robotics ER 2 is now available in public preview on the Gemini platform.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們將同一套前沿具身推理模型帶入企業生產環境：Gemini Robotics ER 2現已在Gemini平台公開預覽。

items_flat.title_en: NVIDIA invests $3 billion in Meta and expands collaboration on Muse agents
items_flat.title_zh: NVIDIA 投資 Meta 30 億美元並擴大 Muse 代理合作
items_flat.summary_en: NVIDIA and Meta announced an expanded partnership on Muse and the Muse family of models to improve inference and training performance, alongside a $3 billion NVIDIA investment in Meta’s equity offering. Meta plans to expand deployment of NVIDIA Vera Rubin and related infrastructure.
items_flat.summary_zh: NVIDIA 與 Meta 宣布擴大 Muse 與 Muse 模型家族合作以改善推論與訓練效能，並由 NVIDIA 投資 Meta 股權發行 30 億美元。Meta 計畫擴大部署 NVIDIA Vera Rubin 等基礎設施。
items_flat.analysis_en: The deal ties capital, hardware and model optimization together for Meta’s personal-agent push, but it is part of a larger equity raise and does not by itself change Muse’s current capabilities or availability.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 此交易將資本、硬體與模型優化綁定，以支援 Meta 的個人代理推進，但它是更大規模股權籌資的一部分，本身並未改變 Muse 的現有能力或可用性。
items_flat.quote: AI agents represent a new computing paradigm — software that understands our goals, reasons, uses tools and gets work done on our behalf.
items_flat.quote_zh: AI 代理代表新的運算典範——能理解我們的目標、推理、使用工具並代我們完成工作的軟體。

items_flat.title_en: Mistral launches Responses API in public preview for agent building
items_flat.title_zh: Mistral 推出 Responses API 公開預覽，用於代理建置
items_flat.summary_en: Mistral introduced the Responses API in public preview, returning the model’s answer, reasoning and tool calls as separate items to make agent construction easier than Chat Completions. It works with all Mistral-hosted chat models including Large 4 and is stateless.
items_flat.summary_zh: Mistral 推出 Responses API 公開預覽，將模型答案、推理與工具呼叫作為獨立項目返回，使代理建置比 Chat Completions 更簡單。它適用於所有 Mistral 託管聊天模型（包括 Large 4），且為無狀態。
items_flat.analysis_en: Aligning with the OpenAI Responses format lowers switching cost for agent developers, but the preview is still stateless and early; production readiness and parity with larger labs remain to be proven.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 與 OpenAI Responses 格式對齊降低代理開發者的切換成本，但預覽仍為無狀態且早期；生產就緒度與與大型實驗室的對等性仍待證明。
items_flat.quote: Today, we’re introducing the Responses API in public preview, made for building agents on Mistral.
items_flat.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出 Responses API 公開預覽，專為在 Mistral 上建置代理而設計。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic expands AI for Science program to foundations and research institutions
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 將 AI for Science 計畫擴大至基金會與研究機構
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic highlighted partnerships with 20 scientific foundations, institutions and research groups in an expansion of its AI for Science program, providing free Claude credits. Partners include the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation, Simons Foundation, US National Science Foundation, Wellcome Sanger Institute, EMBL, Gladstone Institutes and projects such as FlyWire and gnomAD.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 強調與 20 個科學基金會、機構與研究團體合作，擴大 AI for Science 計畫並提供免費 Claude 點數。合作夥伴包括 Alfred P. Sloan Foundation、Simons Foundation、美國國家科學基金會、Wellcome Sanger Institute、EMBL、Gladstone Institutes，以及 FlyWire 與 gnomAD 等專案。
items_flat.analysis_en: Extending free credits through institutional partners multiplies reach beyond individual researchers, yet the scientific impact will hinge on whether the resulting open datasets, tools and discoveries materialize at scale.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 透過機構合作夥伴延伸免費點數，將觸及範圍從個人研究者擴大，但科學影響將取決於產生的開放資料集、工具與發現能否大規模實現。
items_flat.quote: We’re highlighting 20 scientific foundations, institutions, and research groups around the world that we’ve partnered with in an expansion of our AI for Science program.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們強調與全球 20 個科學基金會、機構與研究團體合作，以擴大 AI for Science 計畫。

anthropic.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出法律專業人士可依團隊工作方式調整、並與企業同事分享的即用型artifacts。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic expands GSA partnership with 40% discount for all levels of US government
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic 擴大 GSA 合作，為美國各級政府提供 40% 折扣
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic expanded its GSA agreement to offer a 40% discount on Claude Enterprise, Claude for Government and the Claude API across federal, state, local, tribal and territorial governments, with no minimum spend. Roughly 500 government organizations already use Claude.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic 擴大 GSA 協議，為聯邦、州、地方、部落與領地政府提供 Claude Enterprise、Claude for Government 與 Claude API 40% 折扣，無最低消費。約 500 個政府組織已使用 Claude。
anthropic.analysis_en: The discount lowers barriers for public-sector adoption amid long procurement cycles and tight budgets, but actual uptake still depends on security authorizations and agency implementation.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 此折扣在漫長採購週期與緊縮預算中降低公共部門採用門檻，但實際採用仍取決於安全授權與機構執行。
anthropic.quote: We are expanding our partnership with the General Services Administration (GSA) through a new agreement that gives government partners a 40% discount on Claude Enterprise, Claude for Government, and the Claude API.
anthropic.quote_zh: 我們透過新協議擴大與總務署（GSA）的合作，給予政府合作夥伴在Claude Enterprise、Claude for Government與Claude API上40%的折扣。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic expands AI for Science program to foundations and research institutions
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic 將 AI for Science 計畫擴大至基金會與研究機構
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic highlighted partnerships with 20 scientific foundations, institutions and research groups in an expansion of its AI for Science program, providing free Claude credits. Partners include the Alfred P. Sloan Foundation, Simons Foundation, US National Science Foundation, Wellcome Sanger Institute, EMBL, Gladstone Institutes and projects such as FlyWire and gnomAD.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic 強調與 20 個科學基金會、機構與研究團體合作，擴大 AI for Science 計畫並提供免費 Claude 點數。合作夥伴包括 Alfred P. Sloan Foundation、Simons Foundation、美國國家科學基金會、Wellcome Sanger Institute、EMBL、Gladstone Institutes，以及 FlyWire 與 gnomAD 等專案。
anthropic.analysis_en: Extending free credits through institutional partners multiplies reach beyond individual researchers, yet the scientific impact will hinge on whether the resulting open datasets, tools and discoveries materialize at scale.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 透過機構合作夥伴延伸免費點數，將觸及範圍從個人研究者擴大，但科學影響將取決於產生的開放資料集、工具與發現能否大規模實現。
anthropic.quote: We’re highlighting 20 scientific foundations, institutions, and research groups around the world that we’ve partnered with in an expansion of our AI for Science program.
anthropic.quote_zh: 我們強調與全球 20 個科學基金會、機構與研究團體合作，以擴大 AI for Science 計畫。

google.title_en: Google DeepMind announces Gemini 4 Carbon as next frontier model with cybersecurity focus
google.title_zh: Google DeepMind 宣布 Gemini 4 Carbon 為下一款前沿模型，聚焦網路安全
google.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 4 Carbon on October 28 as its strongest model, ranking #1 on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0 at 59 with state-of-the-art cybersecurity performance (e.g., 88.2% on SEC-bench Pro for vulnerabilities, 54.8% on ExploitGym, 71.0% on CWE-bench). It is initially available to a subset of cyber defenders via the Fairwind Program while undergoing U.S. voluntary pre-release testing, at introductory pricing of $2/$10 per million tokens.
google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 於 10 月 28 日宣布 Gemini 4 Carbon 為其最強模型，在 Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0 以 59 分奪冠，並在網路安全任務（如 SEC-bench Pro 88.2%）表現領先。初期僅向 Fairwind 計畫的網路防禦者開放，正接受美國自願預發布測試，入門價格為每百萬 token $2/$10。
google.analysis_en: Carbon demonstrates rapid iteration in Google’s Gemini 4 series and prioritizes high-stakes defense use cases, but staged rollout and reliance on internal/external benchmarks leave independent validation and broad availability timelines uncertain.
google.analysis_zh: Carbon 顯示 Gemini 4 系列快速迭代並優先高風險防禦用例，但分階段推出與依賴內外部基準，使獨立驗證與廣泛可用時間仍不確定。
google.quote: Today, we’re announcing the next frontier model: Gemini 4 Carbon, our strongest model with state-of-the-art cybersecurity and long horizon capabilities.
google.quote_zh: 今天，我們宣布下一款前沿模型：Gemini 4 Carbon，我們最強的模型，具備最先進的網路安全與長視野能力。

google.title_en: Google DeepMind announces Genie 4 world model with native audio and real-time steering
google.title_zh: Google DeepMind 宣布 Genie 4 世界模型，具備原生音訊與即時導引
google.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced Genie 4, a next-generation world model that generates photorealistic interactive environments with native audio (ambient sound, music, dialogue) and allows real-time natural-language steering of scenes. Simulations incorporate Gemini Omni and other Gemini models for coherence; it is in research preview for trusted testers, with broader access planned for Google AI Ultra and API partners.
google.summary_zh: Google DeepMind 宣布 Genie 4，新一代世界模型可生成具原生音訊（環境音、音樂、對話）的擬真互動環境，並允許以自然語言即時導引場景。模擬整合 Gemini Omni 等模型以維持連貫性；目前向受信任測試者提供研究預覽，計畫擴大至 Google AI Ultra 與 API 合作夥伴。
google.analysis_en: Genie 4 advances interactive simulation for robotics training, creative tools and agent evaluation, but coherence remains limited to short sessions and object permanence can still degrade.
google.analysis_zh: Genie 4 推進機器人訓練、創意工具與代理評估的互動模擬，但連貫性仍限於短時段，物件持久性仍可能下降。
google.quote: Today, we’re announcing our research on Genie 4, our new world model that brings unprecedented realism and native audio to real-time interactive simulation.
google.quote_zh: 今天，我們宣布 Genie 4 的研究，我們的新世界模型為即時互動模擬帶來前所未有的擬真度與原生音訊。

google.title_en: Gemini Robotics Embodied Reasoning 2 enters public preview on Google Cloud
google.title_zh: Gemini Robotics Embodied Reasoning 2 在 Google Cloud 進入公開預覽
google.summary_en: Google Cloud made Gemini Robotics Embodied Reasoning 2 (ER 2) available in public preview on the Gemini platform. The specialized model serves as a high-level robot brain for spatial-temporal reasoning, long-horizon planning, self-correction and tool use.
google.summary_zh: Google Cloud 讓 Gemini Robotics Embodied Reasoning 2 (ER 2) 在 Gemini 平台進入公開預覽。此專用模型作為高階機器人大腦，用於時空推理、長視野規劃、自我修正與工具使用。
google.analysis_en: Putting a frontier embodied-reasoning model into production cloud tooling lowers the barrier for enterprise physical AI, but real-world reliability, safety guardrail performance and latency remain open questions.
google.analysis_zh: 將前沿具身推理模型放入生產雲端工具降低企業實體 AI 門檻，但真實世界可靠性、安全防護表現與延遲仍是開放問題。
google.quote: Today, we are bringing this same frontier embodied reasoning model to enterprise production environments: Gemini Robotics ER 2 is now available in public preview on the Gemini platform.
google.quote_zh: 今天，我們將同一套前沿具身推理模型帶入企業生產環境：Gemini Robotics ER 2現已在Gemini平台公開預覽。

meta.title_en: Meta partners with five US universities, providing $2M and Muse model access for science and medicine
meta.title_zh: Meta 與五所美國大學合作，提供 200 萬美元與 Muse 模型存取以推進科學與醫學
meta.summary_en: Meta announced partnerships on October 28 with Caltech, Ohio State College of Medicine, LSU, Indiana University and UTHealth Houston, granting $2 million across projects plus access to Muse models (including Wonder, Spark Open, Glimmer), computer vision models and SeamlessM4T for research in medicine, physics, chemistry, biology and mathematics.
meta.summary_zh: Meta 於 10 月 28 日宣布與 Caltech、Ohio State 醫學院、LSU、Indiana University 與 UTHealth Houston 合作，提供共 200 萬美元並開放 Muse 模型（包括 Wonder、Spark Open、Glimmer）、電腦視覺模型與 SeamlessM4T，用於醫學、物理、化學、生物與數學研究。
meta.analysis_en: The initiative extends Meta’s open-weight models into applied academic research, particularly healthcare, but outcomes will depend on how effectively teams translate model access into validated scientific results.
meta.analysis_zh: 此計畫將 Meta 的開放權重模型延伸至應用學術研究，尤其是醫療保健，但成果將取決於團隊如何有效將模型存取轉化為經過驗證的科學結果。
meta.quote: Today we're announcing support for university research at Caltech, Ohio State Med, LSU, Indiana Univ, and UTHealth Houston to help advance breakthroughs across science and medicine.
meta.quote_zh: 今天我們宣布支持 Caltech、Ohio State Med、LSU、Indiana Univ 與 UTHealth Houston 的大學研究，以協助推進科學與醫學的突破。

meta.title_en: NVIDIA invests $3 billion in Meta and expands collaboration on Muse agents
meta.title_zh: NVIDIA 投資 Meta 30 億美元並擴大 Muse 代理合作
meta.summary_en: NVIDIA and Meta announced an expanded partnership on Muse and the Muse family of models to improve inference and training performance, alongside a $3 billion NVIDIA investment in Meta’s equity offering. Meta plans to expand deployment of NVIDIA Vera Rubin and related infrastructure.
meta.summary_zh: NVIDIA 與 Meta 宣布擴大 Muse 與 Muse 模型家族合作以改善推論與訓練效能，並由 NVIDIA 投資 Meta 股權發行 30 億美元。Meta 計畫擴大部署 NVIDIA Vera Rubin 等基礎設施。
meta.analysis_en: The deal ties capital, hardware and model optimization together for Meta’s personal-agent push, but it is part of a larger equity raise and does not by itself change Muse’s current capabilities or availability.
meta.analysis_zh: 此交易將資本、硬體與模型優化綁定，以支援 Meta 的個人代理推進，但它是更大規模股權籌資的一部分，本身並未改變 Muse 的現有能力或可用性。
meta.quote: AI agents represent a new computing paradigm — software that understands our goals, reasons, uses tools and gets work done on our behalf.
meta.quote_zh: AI 代理代表新的運算典範——能理解我們的目標、推理、使用工具並代我們完成工作的軟體。

frontier_other.title_en: Mistral launches Responses API in public preview for agent building
frontier_other.title_zh: Mistral 推出 Responses API 公開預覽，用於代理建置
frontier_other.summary_en: Mistral introduced the Responses API in public preview, returning the model’s answer, reasoning and tool calls as separate items to make agent construction easier than Chat Completions. It works with all Mistral-hosted chat models including Large 4 and is stateless.
frontier_other.summary_zh: Mistral 推出 Responses API 公開預覽，將模型答案、推理與工具呼叫作為獨立項目返回，使代理建置比 Chat Completions 更簡單。它適用於所有 Mistral 託管聊天模型（包括 Large 4），且為無狀態。
frontier_other.analysis_en: Aligning with the OpenAI Responses format lowers switching cost for agent developers, but the preview is still stateless and early; production readiness and parity with larger labs remain to be proven.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 與 OpenAI Responses 格式對齊降低代理開發者的切換成本，但預覽仍為無狀態且早期；生產就緒度與與大型實驗室的對等性仍待證明。
frontier_other.quote: Today, we’re introducing the Responses API in public preview, made for building agents on Mistral.
frontier_other.quote_zh: 今天，我們推出 Responses API 公開預覽，專為在 Mistral 上建置代理而設計。

brief_en: Google DeepMind launched Gemini 4 Carbon as its top frontier model with cybersecurity leads and #1 on Artificial Analysis Index v5; Anthropic expanded AI for Science partnerships; OpenAI and ServiceNow deepened enterprise ties; Meta and NVIDIA advanced Muse collaboration.
brief_zh: Google DeepMind 推出 Gemini 4 Carbon，主打網路安全並奪得 Artificial Analysis 指數冠軍；Anthropic 擴大科學合作；OpenAI 與 ServiceNow 深化企業整合；Meta 與 NVIDIA 推進 Muse 合作。
